fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami’s public tolerance and leisure culture (including racing and nightlife), letters to the editor, and local civic concerns. Coverage discusses a proposed approach to eliminating drawbridges on the Miami River, landlord-tenant enforcement and police response in Miami Beach, and notes on aviation and radio communications (including reporting tied to Opa-locka). The issue also contains political commentary, society/column items, and extensive advertisements for hotels, restaurants, clubs, entertainment, and local businesses in Miami and Miami Beach.
